transcript: I am a final year software engineering student and I like UI UX design work. I know some Figma via frames and usability testing. I did a customer support chat box for customer service. It was not a big project but I learned things from it. My project part was about intent, flow design and response testing. There were many problems, main read, wrong responses for similar questions. We fixed it after trying many times. I want this job because I like ITN. I think I can do work. Sometimes I get nervous and I forget some points. This project was helped me understand teamwork and basic user experience.
feedback: You provided a good overview of your project experience, but could improve by providing more specific details about your role and accomplishments. weaknesses: Seemed nervous and forgot some points
suggestions: Practice answering behavioral questions using the STAR method to provide more structured responses
Use more professional vocabulary, such as 'design principles' instead of 'frames'

better_answer_example: In my final year software engineering project, I worked on designing a customer support chat box for a company's customer service team. I applied my knowledge of Figma to create a user-friendly interface, and conducted usability testing to identify areas for improvement. One of the challenges we faced was ensuring the chat box could accurately respond to similar questions, which required careful intent and flow design. Through this project, I developed my skills in teamwork, user experience design, and problem-solving, and I believe these skills would be a great fit for this role at ITN.
